program:
app "Language practice" book ocean
table drill name text
table drill_done drill ref drill
let n = count(drill)
screen main "Today" check
  count(drill_done today) "of" n "done today" head
  each drill
    row card gap 2 tap edit it swipe remove it
      stack grow
        it.name bold
        streak(it.drill_done) "day streak" faint
      toggle it.drill_done
  form drill
screen stats "Stats" chart
  stat round(count(drill_done week) * 100 / (n * weekday(today))), "% done this week"
  stat round(count(drill_done last 30 days) * 100 / (n * 30)), "% in 30 days"
describe:
Language practice, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- drill: name: text. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- drill done: drill: a drill. Every entry also keeps when it was added.

- n is how many drill entries.

  - text: how many drill done entries today, "of", n, "done today".
  - for each drill:
    - a group; a tap opens the drill for editing; a swipe removes the drill, with undo:
      - text: its name.
      - text: the current day streak of its drill done entries, "day streak".

  - a big number: how many drill done entries in the last 30 days times 100 divided by the result of n times 30 rounded, labelled "% in 30 days".

program:
app "Tool shed" tool slate
table tool name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 5, kind pick Daily|Weekly|Rare
let short = count(tool, it.qty <= it.low)
short "tools running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
each tool sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
      i.kind faint
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
form tool
describe:
Tool shed, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- tool: name: text; qty: number, at least 0; low: number, at least 0, starts at 5; kind: one of Daily, Weekly, Rare. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- short is how many of the tool have its qty is at most its low.
Shows:
- text: short, "tools running low".
- for each tool sorted by qty:
  - a group; a tap opens the tool for editing; a swipe removes the tool, with undo:
    - text: the name of the tool.
    - text: the kind of the tool.
    - a button "-"; a tap sets the qty of the tool to the qty of the tool minus 1.
    - text: the qty of the tool.
    - a button "+"; a tap sets the qty of the tool to the qty of the tool plus 1.
- a form to add a tool.

table tap
setting lim num = 100 "Round size"
let n = count(tap today)
draw width 240 tap add tap
  circle 44 stroke soft thick 8
  arc 44, 0, 360 * (n % lim) / lim stroke accent thick 8
  label 50, 48, n % lim big

"Rounds done" floor(n / lim) head
"Total today" n faint
when n > 0 and n % lim = 0 notify "Round complete"

- when n is more than 0 and n leaves over when divided by lim is 0, it shows the notice "Round complete".

each bd as b
  let nx = addmonths(b.date, 12 * (year(today) - year(b.date)))

  row card gap 2 tap edit b swipe remove b
    b.name bold grow
    b.kind faint
    nb - today "days" big
form bd
describe:

program:
app "Car Service" car slate
table service day date, km num 0.., done text, cost money, garage text, next_km num 0..
setting now_km num = 5 "Current km"
let due = last(service.next_km)
if(now_km >= due and due > 0, "Service is due", "Next service at") due "km" head color if(now_km >= due and due > 0, warn, ink)
"Total spent" sum(service.cost all) faint
form service, "Add service"
each service sort day desc
  row card tap edit it swipe remove it
    stack grow
      it.day it.km "km" bold
      it.done "at" it.garage faint
    it.cost bold
describe:
Car Service, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- service: day: date; km: number, at least 0; done: text; cost: money; garage: text; next km: number, at least 0. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Current km": number, starts at 5.
Works out:
- due is the latest next km of service.
Shows:
- text: "Service is due" when now km is at least due and due is more than 0, otherwise "Next service at", due, "km".
- text: "Total spent", the total cost of service.
- a form to add a service.
- for each service sorted by day, highest first:
  - a group; a tap opens the service for editing; a swipe removes the service, with undo:
    - text: its day, its km, "km".
    - text: its done, "at", its garage.
    - text: its cost.
hurried_style: a short question, 4 to 10 words
fuller_style: chatty with a reason why the person needs it, 22 to 38 words
order: start with who it is for
